outcome: Expression of key genes involved in fatty acid oxidation and esterification in placental tissue
cohort: Fifty-five healthy, normal glucose tolerant women from Honolulu, Hawaii, were recruited, dichotomized based on pre-pregnancy BMI into lean (BMI <25 kg/m2) and obese (BMI >30 kg/m2).
finding: In Hawaii, placental lipid content, expression of fatty acid oxidation/esterification genes, and TNF-alpha levels were similar between lean and obese women, despite lower DHA levels in obese women, likely due to overall high omega-3 intake compared to other populations.
